title: boesenbergia ornata
intro: Boesenbergia ornata, commonly known as Ginger Lily or Thai Ginger, is a species of flowering plant in the family Zingiberaceae. It is a popular ornamental plant due to its striking red, orange, and yellow flowers and vibrant green leaves. The health benefits of Boesenbergia ornata include its ability to alleviate symptoms of nausea and digestive issues, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain and improving cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of Boesenbergia ornata include gingerols, shogaols, and diarylheptanoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
